component.name: AlphaLink CAM
component.summary: Lathe CAM for the Harrison Alpha 400T

description.p: Draw a turned part, set up roughing, finishing, facing, grooving, threading and drilling, and make the Alpha-T program the control's macros expect, byte for byte like the original ALPHA-T DOS CAM.
Send it over RS-232 to the lathe and back up the Manual Ops. Works with touch, pen, mouse and keyboard.
First version: drawing, all ALPHA-T operations, program preview and simulation, serial send and Manual Ops backup.
